title: Cardinal
subtitle: Red that does not ask for the room. It simply takes it.

stone.origin: The ruby has always commanded red. Not suggested it. Not approximated it. Cardinal answers that command in full. This is not a bracelet that asks for attention. It simply is.

description: The ruby has always commanded red — not suggested it, not approximated it, but held the colour at full authority. Cardinal answers that command in kind: a continuous line of rubies carried in eighteen-karat rose gold, the warm metal chosen to read at the same temperature as the stones so nothing cools the colour. Set close, stone to stone, the red gathers into one uninterrupted field around the wrist. This is not a bracelet that asks for attention. It simply is.
